raggiesoft.dev — The Open-Source Code Behind RaggieSoft's Projects

Every RaggieSoft software engine, compiler, desktop workstation, and web framework is 100% open source under the MIT License, paired with CC BY-SA 4.0 across our novels, music, and worldbuilding. Each language and engineering stack gets its own dedicated <project>.raggiesoft.dev portal—starting with raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev and finsharp.raggiesoft.dev (both dogfooded & compiled by RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.7.0!).

RaggieSoft Installer Studio & Studio Suite (v0.9.0 Shipping • Archive v0.5.0–v0.9.0)

RaggieSoft Labs • Linear-Type .NET / Roslyn Compiler

Fin# (Financial Sharp — /labs/finsharp)

Born from Ocean View Archives (/books/aubrie): an experimental domain-specific financial programming language & compiler (finsc) replacing mutable scalar decimals with linear Capital<TCurrency> resource types so unbalanced journal entries halt at compile time with FIN0001: ConservationOfCapitalViolationException.
